// Package probe_test checks DECISIONS 401 and CODEGEN.md §5.9 (Addresses) on generated Go
// (TestStableAddressesGo): baked rows (bk), a types-mode holder (ty) and a reloadable snapshot
// (da). It reads the data file the build wrote at ../../da/out/items.json, and prints one
// `<check> ok` line for each check that holds, the test failing for one that does not.
package probe_test

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.com/gen/bk"
	"example.com/gen/da"
	"example.com/gen/ty"
)

func check(t *testing.T, name string, ok bool) {
	t.Helper()
	if !ok {
		t.Error(name + " FAIL")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(name + " ok")
}

func TestBakedAddresses(t *testing.T) {
	st := bk.GetStatuses()
	open, _ := st.Find("open")
	taken, _ := st.Find("taken")
	check(t, "baked-find-is-at", open == st.At(0))
	var all []*bk.Status
	for row := range st.All() {
		all = append(all, row)
	}
	check(t, "baked-find-is-all", all[0] == open)
	id, _ := bk.ParseStatusID("taken")
	check(t, "baked-get-is-find", st.Get(id) == taken)
	check(t, "baked-accessors-repeat", st.At(1) == st.At(1) && st == bk.GetStatuses())
	tasks := bk.GetTasks()
	firstTask, _ := tasks.Find("first")
	check(t, "baked-keyed-find-is-at", firstTask == tasks.At(0))
	second, _ := tasks.Find("second")
	check(t, "baked-getter-is-find", second.Status() == open)
	check(t, "baked-getter-repeats", second.Status() == second.Status())
	check(t, "baked-element-is-find", open.Next().At(0) == taken)
	copied := open.Next()
	check(t, "baked-copied-list-same-pointer", copied.At(0) == taken)
}

func TestTypesAddresses(t *testing.T) {
	text := `{"items": [{"id": 1, "name": "a"}, {"id": 2, "name": "b"}], "w": {"3": {"id": 3, "name": "c"}}}`
	h, err := ty.DecodeHolder([]byte(text))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	list := h.Items()
	one, _ := list.Find(1)
	check(t, "types-find-is-at", one == list.At(0) && one == h.Items().At(0))
	var all []*ty.Item
	for row := range list.All() {
		all = append(all, row)
	}
	check(t, "types-find-is-all", all[0] == one)
	copied := list
	got, _ := copied.Find(1)
	check(t, "types-copied-keyed-list-same-pointer", got == one && copied.At(0) == one)
	again := h.Items()
	gotAgain, _ := again.Find(1)
	check(t, "types-getter-repeats", gotAgain == one)
}

func TestReloadKeepsAddresses(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("../../da/out/items.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	dir := t.TempDir()
	path := filepath.Join(dir, "items.json")
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, raw, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := da.Store.Reload(dir); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	old := da.Store.Current()
	a, _ := old.Items().Find("a")
	check(t, "data-find-is-at", a == old.Items().At(0))
	changed := strings.Replace(string(raw), `"qty": 1`, `"qty": 9`, 1)
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(changed), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := da.Store.Reload(dir); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fresh := da.Store.Current()
	check(t, "data-reload-swaps-snapshot", fresh != old)
	check(t, "data-held-row-reads-old-value", a.Name() == "a" && a.Qty() == 1)
	again, _ := old.Items().Find("a")
	check(t, "data-held-snapshot-keeps-address", again == a)
	newRow, _ := fresh.Items().Find("a")
	check(t, "data-new-snapshot-has-own-rows", newRow.Qty() == 9 && newRow != a)
}
